scope: Only known public10 demo inputs and actually displayed cards from root browser run. Development only; no unseen quality, conversion or performance pass in this plan.
checks: Bind expected/effective public request, actual POST, response request IDs/stages and displayed canonical identity/color/price. Use each actual request history after any action, not stale seed assumptions.

Assess ranking against observable public activities/interests and query/budget/hard constraints; report plausible versus unsupported complements without imposing a hidden unique-primary label. Record owned repeats unless request explicitly asks replacement/repeat.

Audit all actually displayed accepted native titles/badges/bodies/section headings for source identity/color/price/feature truth and usable short-caption fluency. Missing price in body alone is not harmful when structured price is visible. No exact teacher wording or long grammar requirement.

Separate metadata-only fallback and withheld fields from freshly accepted generated copy; do not promote failed/withheld raw text. Canonical subtitle may establish identity, but is not fresh generated text.

Bind variant to canonical public asset/gallery source and observed currentSrc, image decode, geometry, clipping and DPR. Inspect screenshots locally when available. Source binding and visual pixel assessment are distinct; mark uncertain color appearance honestly.

Check selected profile displayName/summary/preferences and captured recent-history panel against source. When popup is closed or uncaptured, mark visible context unverified while separately checking POST context.

Retain frozen probe denominator and all failed/unattempted cases. First-three usable visible readiness and full-six completion remain distinct; no ranking-only or raw request time called full UI latency.
Report exact source/model/health/cache provenance from receipts; preparation-source hashes must be compared to actual run before/after snapshots. No browser/model/GPU action by auditor.
publicKnownDemoCriterion: Existing known-development acceptance includes a sofa-complement throw within Bob first3; record actual outcome without retuning or claiming unseen evidence.
forbiddenReadsOrActions: futurev4 private labels or model output files before root sealed-quality-run authorization
